World Chaos Map · live since January 2026

Can one fair rule, and no opinions, rank the whole world's chaos from the news?

Method

Every four hours, read 486 audited feeds plus GDELT. Score each article on evidence of harm. No country appears in any list, cap or override.

Readings

  • v3.2 deleted every country-specific patch from v2.
  • Replayed on 7 Oct: France 79 → 62, Myanmar 55 → 68, Syria 26 → 51.
  • Of 1,162 feeds listed, only about 420 had ever worked. 486 remain.

Next

Confidence for each story, a check on alarming claims, and conflict data from UCDP.

      One Sentence · live, invite only

      Can strangers write a story that holds together if each one sees only the line before theirs?

      Method

      No profiles, no likes, no audience. You read one sentence, write the next, and never see the story again. Email checks exist only to keep it human.

      2Vv

      VerumVeil · three ciphers, 2024

      Can a secret sit in plain sight, in a row of faces, and stay a secret?

      Method

      Three ways to hide in plain sight. AI Sentence Crypt turns your message into an ordinary sentence that means something else. SkipCode, borrowed from Sherlock's The Empty Hearse, buries it among innocent words. Emoji Crypt, the one here, turns it into faces. The password decides everything.

      Readings

      Honest result: Emoji Crypt is a substitution cipher. It hides a short note from a glance, but frequency analysis would crack a long one. GitHub ↗

      Instrument

      Runs in your browser. Change the password and try to open it.

      1Ld

      Last Drink · in design, name not final

      Can a drinking app reward going slower instead of drinking more?

      Method

      Points stop at hourly, nightly and weekly caps. Water between rounds earns points. There is no progress bar to chase, and alerts flag sudden spikes. Safeguards borrowed from gambling, from day one.

      Why me

      Five years behind London bars. I have watched the third drink turn into the sixth more times than I can count.

      Instrument

      0points tonight

      Start the night. Two an hour earn points. Water counts only between drinks.

        LifeOS · research since February 2026, working name

        Can parts of how one person thinks and behaves be modelled honestly, and updated as they change?

        Method

        Cognitive psychology, behaviour data and machine learning, building toward a personal digital twin. My final year project is the first narrow, testable piece.

        Readings

        Early. The research plan lives on shawsuraj.com ↗

        Instrument

        When did you wake up this week? The model guesses tomorrow.

        07:00

        An average with an honest range. A real twin has to explain the late nights, not just widen the range. That gap is the research.

         2026SpSky Portalcoursework

        Explored email spoofing through a small web form. Retired once SPF, DKIM and DMARC bounced every message, which was the lesson.

        Turns any video into a barcode of its colours, one stripe per frame. Python, v1.5.
